digest.component_or_area: Reconciler, runner, and operation snapshot architecture
propositions: Reconciler Mutation uses generic dict payload instead of discriminated union by (direction, action); outbound typed mutations convert through legacy _mutation_to_batch_dict and polymorphic applier.apply.
PydanticAIRunner.run() has grown seams across ProviderSession, model_classes, structured_run, agent_call, runner_support that lack cohesive ownership boundaries and fault matrix documentation.
OperationSnapshot is authoritative for reconciler bindings but CLI/shared paths still call emit_shadow_snapshot and independently resolve LLMConfig.from_env, creating duplicate ambient-config reads.
reconcile.py and reconcile_helpers.py exceed 700-line headroom target; producer inputs bundle 24 values without typed discrimination.
Shadow replay must prove typed-payload behavior equivalence before production cutover; legacy dispatch and dictionary translation must be deleted in the same epic.
